title: Real lift at a negative leading sign
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $f$ be a function from $\\{-1,1\\}^n$ to the signs $\\{\\pm1\\}$, and let $x\\in\\{-1,1\\}^n$. After interpreting the outputs as real numbers, the balanced lift of $f$ at the vector with first coordinate $-1$ and remaining coordinates $x$ equals $-f(-x)$.
